description: Tools for working with institutional repositories and data management systems. Current implementation targets Invenio-RDM.
name: irdmtools
releaseNotes:
- This release modernizes the build, release and documentation. The tools behave as in v0.0.98 except for the one fix below.
- Fixed four malformed struct tags that `go vet` reported (`config.go`, `eprintrest.go`). `EPrintRest` now decodes `db_host`, `db_user` and `db_password` from JSON, and a `debug:` key in a YAML configuration no longer sets `Config.Debug`; it is a command line flag only.
- A fresh clone builds: `version.go` is committed again (a clean checkout failed with `undefined: Version`).
- The Makefile: `build`, `test` and `install` no longer run `cmt`, so building needs only git, make, go and pandoc. `cmt` runs only from `make generate` and `make release`.
- `make release` builds one zip per platform (Linux, macOS and Windows, on x86_64 and arm64) and `release-check` fails when a zip lacks a program or carries a stale version or manual page. The 32-bit Raspberry Pi (Linux-armv7l) build is dropped; a Pi is supported as Linux-aarch64.
- `release.bash` and `release.ps1` were rewritten and share one test driver (`make test-release`).
- Tests: `make test` is offline; the tests that need an RDM or Postgres configuration skip themselves, and the ones that call public APIs (DataCite, CrossRef, ROR) run only with `make test-live`.
- Documentation sources moved to `docs/` and are published by the shared workflow; the Python scripts and the `irdm` package moved to `scripts/`; working notes moved to the workspace; the site hostname is software.library.caltech.edu.
- `codemeta.json` is CodeMeta 4.0 and no longer lists CMTools as a requirement.
